plugins.name: qoq
plugins.description: QoQ "quality over quantity" toolkit for JavaScript/TypeScript projects — one skill, six commands over a single shared project discovery. `/qoq fix` clears tool findings (Prettier, ESLint, Knip, JSCPD, Stylelint) in a budgeted check/fix loop ending on a PASS/FAIL verdict other skills can call. `/qoq refactor` runs four sequential judgement passes over a scope: duplication, project conventions, minimalism, design patterns. `/qoq bump` upgrades npm dependencies one attributable patch at a time. `/qoq plan` decomposes a spec into a milestone/ticket plan file under `./plans/`. `/qoq execute` delivers that plan ticket by ticket under TDD. `/qoq test` writes Vitest/Jest coverage for code that already exists. Bundles five subagents.
